name: Urlala
description: Save and organize your favorite websites with Smart Bookmark Manager. Quickly add bookmarks, manage URLs, keep important links in folders, and access your favorite pages whenever you need them.

scripts.build:firefox: pnpm run paraglide:compile && wxt build -b firefox
scripts.build:safari: pnpm run paraglide:compile && wxt build -b safari && xcrun safari-web-extension-converter .output/safari-mv2 --project-location .output --app-name Urlala --bundle-identifier com.urlala.extension --no-open
scripts.zip:firefox: pnpm run paraglide:compile && wxt zip -b firefox
scripts.zip:safari: pnpm run paraglide:compile && wxt zip -b safari
